conditionSyntax: brokennes run_until condition, tested at end of frame

level_tileset.note: 0 = world map, nonzero = in a level (1 = plains seen in 1-1/1-2). VERIFIED

map_ready.note: 0 on title, $0D on the world map, $10 in a level. VERIFIED

world.note: 0-based world number. 0 verified on W1; change to 1 NOT yet observed

lives.note: Mario lives (4 at start; 3 after a death). VERIFIED. Luigi $0737

score_backup.note: Mario's saved score copy (mirrors $0715 after a level). VERIFIED

inventory.note: item ids 1 mushroom..8 P-wing. VERIFIED (8 = P-wing worked)

map_powerup.note: Mario power-up kept on the map: 0 small,1 big,2 fire,3 raccoon... VERIFIED (3 after P-wing, 1 -> Big in 1-2)

level_powerup.note: in-level power-up, same encoding. VERIFIED (3 raccoon, 1 big)

completions.note: Map_Completions, Mario: byte per map column, bit per row. 1-1 clear set $7D04 bit7 (VERIFIED). Luigi at $7D40

chapters.note: from power-on + Start,Start: first true at frame 598 with the map fading in
played to it (P-wing route for research); bit set when Mario is back on the map
find the bit at the first clear: diff $7D00-$7D3F before/after (one new bit appears)

chapters.condition: same pattern (fortress tile completion bit) TBD; lock removal follows

generic_rule: a level chapter ends on the first frame where [$070A]==0 && [$0729]==$0D and the popcount of $7D00..$7D3F grew by one versus the chapter's start state
